searchText: Think all these validity conditions should be better specified for sure. But so how can an IL member submit an invalid IL? Seems could be one of a few ways: - There is a transaction in their IL that is invalid on its own - There are two transactions which can't both be valid at the same time - The list is valid, but it conflicts with another list sent by a different committee member Is this an exhaustive list? Right.. besides that. I'd cross-check `check_transaction` in the exexection spec. https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/master/src/ethereum/cancun/fork.py#L332 We don't want transactions that invalidate the block, but transactions that can revert by themselves are okay. (Can someone double check this statement?) Reversions should be fine yes, thanks for the reference too!
